title: Legora Valuation Hits $8.8B After $550M Series E Round
summary:
The Stockholm-based creator of legal AI software is shifting its focus toward autonomous agents that can handle complex, multi step assignments. Legora secured $550M in a Series E round led by Atreides, bringing the company's valuation to $8.8B. New backers include Baron Capital, Capital Group, Fidelity, Glade Brook and J.P. Morgan, and the company plans to expand its operations in North America, Europe, Latin America and Asia-Pacific while deepening the development of its Legora aOS.

The post-money valuation is up from $5.55B following a Series D raise in March. Legora recently reported that its annual recurring revenue surpassed $200M just six months after it had hit the $100M mark. The startup now employs more than 1,000 people and serves 140,000 legal professionals.

selectedTweets.text:
We have raised a $550M Series E at an $8.8B valuation, led by Atreides.

Every major existing investor is back in, and we’re welcoming Baron Capital, Capital Group, Fidelity, Glade Brook and J.P. Morgan. We picked investors who think in decades. Several of them work with law firms and legal teams every day, so they can see where the work is heading.

Lawyers are moving from AI assistants to agents that do multi-step work. The money goes there. We’re growing our teams across North America, Europe, Latin America and Asia-Pacific, and going deeper on the Legora aOS.

Thank you to the 1,000+ people at Legora, and to the 140,000 legal professionals who use what we build.

I say this a lot because I believe it: it’s the best time in history to be a lawyer. We're thankful to be a part of it.
